stem: Pick out a three-word phrase from paragraph 1 that shows Marcus was feeling nervous.
passage:
**The Big Match**

It was the last minute of the football final, and the score was one-all. Marcus dribbled the ball past two defenders. His heart pounded like a drum.

Suddenly, a tall defender slid towards him. Marcus stumbled and almost fell, but he kept the ball. He looked up and saw his best friend, Wei Jie, standing alone near the goal. Marcus passed the ball to **him**.

Wei Jie kicked the ball with all his might. It flew past the goalkeeper and into the net! The crowd went wild. The coach ran over and gave both boys a high five. "That pass was as important as the goal!" he said.
working: A pounding heart is a sign of nerves. Count: His (1) heart (2) pounded (3).
Watch out: ‘pounded like a drum’ is FOUR words. Exact word count or no mark.
